title: Breaking Bad
description: Vince Gilligan's celebrated transformation of mild-mannered chemistry teacher Walter White into the ruthless methamphetamine kingpin Heisenberg.

title: Game of Thrones
description: Nine noble families wage vicious political and military warfare for control over the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient menace awakens in the far North.

title: The Wire
description: David Simon's unflinching sociological panorama of Baltimore institutions, told through the eyes of drug dealers, law enforcement, teachers, and politicians.

title: Succession
description: The Roy siblings engage in cutthroat corporate espionage and psychological warfare to seize control of global media conglomerate Waystar RoyCo.

title: Better Call Saul
description: The tragic moral metamorphosis of earnest underdog attorney Jimmy McGill into flamboyant criminal defender Saul Goodman.

title: Squid Game
description: Desperate, debt-ridden citizens compete in lethal children's games on an isolated island for a forty-five billion won fortune.

title: Stranger Things
description: When a young boy vanishes from Hawkins, Indiana, his friends uncover a telekinetic girl, sinister government experiments, and a shadow realm called the Upside Down.

title: Dark
description: A missing child in the German town of Winden unearths a mind-bending four-generation time travel conspiracy spanning a nuclear power plant cave network.

title: Black Mirror
description: Charlie Brooker's razor-sharp dystopian speculative anthology dissecting technological dependence, algorithmic voyeurism, and artificial consciousness.

title: The Last of Us
description: Hardened smuggler Joel must escort immune teenager Ellie across a post-fungal pandemic wasteland in HBO's acclaimed video game adaptation.

title: Arcane: League of Legends
description: Fortiche and Riot Games weave the heartbreaking origin story of sisters Vi and Jinx amid the socioeconomic conflict between Piltover and Zaun.

title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
description: Aang, the young Avatar who mastered all four elemental arts, awakens from a century in an iceberg to halt the imperial conquest of the Fire Nation.

title: The Office (US)
description: The mundane, eccentric daily antics of Dunder Mifflin Paper Company employees in Scranton, led by well-meaning but cringe-inducing regional manager Michael Scott.

title: Sherlock
description: Benedict Cumberbatch and Martin Freeman modernize Arthur Conan Doyle's legendary consulting detective across twenty-first century London.

title: Fleabag
description: Phoebe Waller-Bridge's dry-witted fourth-wall-breaking portrait of grief, intimacy, and redemption in modern London.
